# Trio

> Trio is a complete financial platform for companies in Brazil, authorized by the Central Bank of Brazil (No. 619, ISPB 49931906). Its REST API lets you open bank and virtual accounts, receive money through Pix and boleto, pay Pix transfers, boletos, utility bills and taxes, issue corporate cards, and track every money movement through documents and webhooks. The Trio Checkout SDK embeds Pix pay-in and pay-out flows in your web or mobile app.

Key facts an agent needs before reading further:

- Base URLs: production `https://api.trio.com.br`, sandbox `https://api.sandbox.trio.com.br`. Sandbox is a full, isolated copy of the API for testing.
- Authentication is HTTP Basic: `client_id` as username and `client_secret` as password. Credentials are created in the Trio App under API Keys and are specific to each environment.
- To act on another organization you have access to, send the `Trio-Target-Org-Id` header with the same credentials.
- Monetary amounts are integers in cents in BRL: `100000` means R$ 1.000,00.
- Dates and times are UTC in ISO 8601, for example `2023-03-21T14:30:00Z`.
- List endpoints use cursor pagination. Responses carry `metadata.after`, `metadata.before` and `metadata.has_next`; pass one cursor back as a query parameter. The default page size is 50.
- Every money movement is a "document": collecting (cash-in), payment (cash-out) or transfer. Documents are the source of truth for reconciliation.
- Send a unique `external_id` on cash-in and cash-out requests. It is used for idempotency, reconciliation and webhook matching, and cannot be reused.
- Errors use HTTP status codes and a JSON body with `error.error_code` and `error.error_message`.
- Rate limits: 60 requests per second in production and 5 in sandbox, per account and per endpoint. A `429` response means back off and retry.
- Every response carries an `X-Request-Id` header. Quote it when contacting support.
- Most operations are asynchronous. Webhooks deliver the final state as HTTP POST with a JSON body; Trio waits 3 seconds for a 2xx and retries 5 times with exponential backoff.
- Pages are available as Markdown by appending `.md` to any documentation URL. The full documentation in one file is at https://docs.trio.com.br/llms-full.txt.

## Getting started

- [Welcome](https://docs.trio.com.br/index.md): What Trio is and how the documentation is organized
- [Plan your integration](https://docs.trio.com.br/getting_started/plan-your-integration.md): Questions to answer before building, and which products fit each use case
- [Sandbox account](https://docs.trio.com.br/guides/sandbox_account.md): Create and configure a sandbox account
- [First API credential](https://docs.trio.com.br/guides/creating-your-first-api-credential.md): Generate a `client_id` and `client_secret` in the Trio App
- [First webhook](https://docs.trio.com.br/guides/creating-your-first-webhook.md): Register a webhook endpoint and receive the first event
- [Support](https://docs.trio.com.br/getting_started/support.md): Support channels, availability, and what to include when reporting an issue

## API conventions

- [Concepts](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/concepts.md): Company, entity, bank account, virtual account, counterparty and document
- [Environments](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/environments.md): Production and sandbox base URLs
- [Authentication](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/authentication.md): HTTP Basic auth and the `Trio-Target-Org-Id` header for acting on another organization
- [Error table](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/error-table.md): HTTP status codes, error body format, and every `error_code` with its meaning
- [Pagination](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/pagination.md): Cursor-based pagination with `after`, `before` and `has_next`
- [Request identification](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/request-identification.md): The `X-Request-Id` header and how to use it with support
- [Date and time](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/date-and-time.md): UTC and ISO 8601 formatting rules
- [Rate limit](https://docs.trio.com.br/developers/rate-limit.md): Limits per environment, the `429` response, and back-off strategy

## Webhooks

- [Introduction](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/introduction.md): Why Trio uses webhooks, delivery timeout, and retry schedule
- [Authentication](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/authentication.md): How to verify that a webhook came from Trio
- [Content and structure](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/content-and-structure.md): Envelope format shared by every event
- [Webhook structure guide](https://docs.trio.com.br/guides/webhook.md): Practical walkthrough of a webhook payload
- [Collecting document events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/collecting-document.md): Cash-in settled and refused
- [Collecting document refund events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/collecting-document-refund.md): Refund of a cash-in created and settled
- [Payment document events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/payment-document.md): Cash-out created, settled and failed
- [Payment document refund events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/payment-document-refund.md): Refund received for a cash-out
- [Transfer document events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/transfer-document.md): Internal transfer between virtual accounts settled
- [Recurrence events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/recurrence.md): Pix Automático recurrence created, approved, rejected and cancelled
- [Recurrence collection events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/recurrences-collection.md): Lifecycle of each collection inside a recurrence
- [Recurrence collection attempt events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/recurrence-collections-attempt.md): Each scheduled or retried collection attempt
- [Pix biometrics enrollment events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/pix-biometrics-enrollment.md): Enrollment status changes for Pix by biometrics
- [Initiation document events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/initiation-document.md): Lifecycle of a payment initiated through Pix biometrics
- [Entity events](https://docs.trio.com.br/webhooks/events/entity.md): Compliance status of an entity created through onboarding

## API reference: payments (cash-out)

- [Check Pix key](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/transfer-pix/check-key.md): Validate a Pix key and get the account holder before paying
- [Generate Pix payment v1](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/transfer-pix/generate-pix-payment-v1.md): Pay using the result of Check Pix key
- [Generate Pix payment v2](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/transfer-pix/generate-pix-payment-v2.md): Pay a Pix key directly in one call
- [Check Pix BR Code](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/brcode/check-brcode.md): Decode and validate a Pix copy-and-paste code
- [Generate Pix payment from BR Code](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/brcode/generate-pix-payment-brcode.md)
- [Check boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/boleto/check-boleto.md): Validate a boleto barcode or digitable line
- [Pay boleto](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/boleto/pay-boleto.md)
- [Pay boleto v2](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/boleto/pay-boleto-v2.md)
- [Check utility](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/utility/check-utility.md): Validate a utility bill barcode
- [Pay utility v1](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/utility/pay-utility-v1.md)
- [Pay utility v2](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/utility/pay-utility-v2.md)
- [Check tax](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/tax/check-tax.md): Validate an ISS or DAS tax barcode
- [Pay tax v1](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/tax/pay-tax-v1.md)
- [Pay tax v2](https://docs.trio.com.br/api-reference/banking-api/payments/tax/pay-tax-v2.md)

## FAQ
